Resource data retains authored properties. Copied UID attributes are removed where present so Godot resolves this project’s script paths. Hashes describe the port files after normalization.

The copied assets/ui/metal_theme.tres has only UID attributes removed; its SHA-256 is 59f9a83ddb08fd53d85e2a37a4bd8cb0c6dfd19153008a4325a147bcd64d9eec. ui/shop.tscn adapts the original ui/hud.tscn Shop subtree into its own scene, retaining anchors, card positions and texture regions, with 14-point card text. Runtime labels and the action handler are reimplemented in scripts/shop.odin.

ui/hud.tscn also adapts the original HUD's Vitals/Ammo/BossPlate/Prompt subtrees, sharing those textures and theme. Q/E/F labels follow this port's controls, and the boss plate is moved below its selected-ability name line. The new scripts/hud.odin supplies predicted/confirmed values without the original framework's game pointers or HUD state handlers.

ui/transitions.tscn adapts the original ui/flow.tscn countdown, wipe and note subtrees with the same steel assets, plus a current wave/rest panel. The countdown box is widened, the recovery note moves below the combat HUD, and dynamic text comes from shared/flow and scripts/transitions.odin.

Runner label scale (0.45), dim tint (0.5 alpha), size and offsets come from the original fx/nameplate.tscn. The downed camera selection derives from scripts/flow.odin's borrowed-eyes behavior; the camera remains owned by this game's root and tracks displayed rigs through generation/warp identities.

ui/chat.tscn uses the original chat scene's steel theme and bottom-left placement, with a scrollable plain-text history in place of its managed line widgets. Yard message sources are the original events.odin, run.odin, brains.odin, combat.odin and succession.odin; shared/flow/news.odin derives those messages from confirmed state transitions, with updated parts/cores wording.

Ping diamond geometry, tint, scale pulse and 2.6-second fade come from original scripts/present.odin. Floating names use the original kit/fx 0.9-second lifetime and 46-pixel/second rise. scripts/pings.odin builds these as native scene nodes and uses the existing copied ping sound.

Runner muzzle cells (weapons.png, 16×16 cells on row zero), the overhead reload region (ui.png, 96,0,32,16), downed pose/beacon and enemy animation frame counts come from original skins.odin, runner.odin and mob.odin. Hit colors/wobble come from present.odin. The new actor view reuses those existing textures and native geometry; no new bitmap assets were generated.

Feedback bursts and floating-text timing derive from original kit/fx/fx.odin; layered death colors/offsets derive from scripts/present.odin. Debris uses native polygon fragments, and damage/pickup labels are generated from observed values.

assets/fx_vignette.png is an unmodified copy of the original, SHA-256 c99ae5bb0f3fd0fc354bc50b7f39fb38fd0814f5e3a3c125408e419232e28f83. The screen scene uses its alpha mask; zoom, health-pulse and floor-fade formulas come from original present.odin/run.odin and are implemented in shared/flow/screen.odin.

entities/scrap.tscn retains original gear/hub geometry and colors, removing the original script attachment and copied UID. Arena/scatter/collision rules come from scripts/arena.odin; dirt/tuft placement and gate art/animation also come from that file. The direction arrow's geometry/color come from fx/gate_arrow.tscn and its visibility/placement rule from scripts/flow.odin. These are implemented in scripts/scenery.odin using the existing copied floor/objects textures. Movement comes from scripts/input.odin. Combat and ability rules come from the original combat/brains sources and retained definitions. See combat and abilities for scope and comparison limits.
